legal.privacy_default: We collect only what is needed to fulfil and support your order: your e-mail, order details, the information you enter in the order form, and technical logs (such as IP address) for fraud prevention. Payments are processed by our payment providers; we never see full card numbers. You may ask us to delete your account data at any time, subject to legal record-keeping duties. This policy is a draft and must be reviewed for your jurisdiction.
legal.review_note: Last reviewed by the store operator. Final terms depend on sales region and product type.
legal.terms_default: By purchasing you agree that digital items are delivered electronically to the order page and e-mail you provide. Do not resell or share delivered items unless the product description allows it. The store may refuse or cancel orders suspected of fraud. These terms are a draft and must be reviewed for your jurisdiction.
